newsitem.title: USA: U.S. donates wheat to aid Mongolia reforms-USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. donates wheat to aid Mongolia reforms-USDA.

text.p: The United States will donate $5 million worth of wheat to Mongolia to support free-market reforms in the agricultural sector, the Agriculture Department announced Friday.

Under a "Food for Progress" agreement, the United States will provide up to 11,000 metric tons of wheat and pay transportation costs to ship it to the Asian nation. The wheat will be sold and proceeds used to support the country's private sector.
USDA will purchase the wheat and donate it before the current fiscal year ends September 30.
The Food for Progress program provides commodities to needy nations to encourage agricultural reform.
